requirements.quote: Add packages/core/src/status (model.ts StatusSnapshot/ComponentStatus/Incident zod; publish.ts building a sanitised, HMAC-signed snapshot from health checks and getAdapterHealthSummary with documented thresholds for operational/degraded/down).
Add platform tables incident and incident_update (no workspace_id, justification comment, test they hold no tenant data) with migration.
Add worker job status.publish (every minute, idempotent, overlap-safe, writes status/status.json to the public static path via the S3 abstraction) and STATUS_SIGNING_KEY env (dev default).

Pre-stage every shared registry here: schema index, core index and cross-tenant registry (NOT_A_SERVICE or SERVICE_TESTS), core-domains doc, worker registry and schedules tests, i18n namespace and catalog test.

Acceptance: snapshot schema, sanitiser fixtures test, adapter threshold mapping tests, signature test, idempotent publish and stale detection (api test), court wording 'Parsing of documents you share'.

deliverables.change: zod schemas + types StatusSnapshot, ComponentStatus (operational|degraded|down), Incident, IncidentUpdate; snapshot has version, generatedAt, components[], incidents[], signature field

thresholds (documented constants: failed+degraded share of runs over a window mapped to operational/degraded/down; no runs = operational), sanitise() allowlist projection, canonical JSON + HMAC-SHA256 sign/verify with STATUS_SIGNING_KEY, buildSnapshot(deps) from health checks + getAdapterHealthSummary, publishStatus (skips write when unsigned-content hash unchanged), isStale(snapshot, now, maxAgeSec). Court component label 'Parsing of documents you share'.
barrel for the status domain; export from packages/core/src/index.ts and add './status' to packages/core/package.json exports

tests: snapshot schema, sanitiser fixtures (no hostnames/errors/workspace ids leak), threshold mapping per adapter, signature valid/tampered/wrong key, idempotent publish (second identical run does not put), stale detection, court wording

defineJob name 'system.status.publish' (NOT status.poll, which is case-watch), schema { workspaceId: null optional }, concurrency 1, singleton key 'status-publish' policy 'stately', schedule cron '* * * * *'; handler calls publishStatus with createObjectStoreFromEnv
import and register statusPublish (list and tuple type); also export from packages/core/src/jobs/index.ts

tables incident (id, title, severity, state, component, started_at, resolved_at, created_by staff ref optional, timestamps) and incident_update (id, incident_id fk, state, body, created_at); no workspace_id; justification comment that they hold only public platform status text; export from schema/index.ts
CREATE TABLE incident, incident_update plus grants consistent with other global tables; regenerate meta/20261025050000_snapshot.json and _journal.json (renumber if the base took the number)
add both tables to the root table list; add a test (or new packages/db/src/__tests__/status-schema.test.ts) asserting neither has a workspace_id column and neither column set can hold tenant data

add a narrow public-object key seam (e.g. publicObjectKey('status/status.json') allowlisted, branded as ObjectKey) so ObjectStore.put can write the public static path; verify s3-provider.ts and memory-provider.ts accept it and extend them if they re-parse keys; export from index.ts; add a test
add STATUS_SIGNING_KEY (secret: true, devDefault placeholder constant like DEV_BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, min length enforced in production); update .env.example via the generator and the env tests

add status domain to CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES (court, storage-free imports only through index.ts); jobs gains status dependency; mirror in docs/engineering/core-domains.md (table row, mermaid, dependency table)
document the status domain and its edges

register every new runtime export of @causedeck/core: NOT_A_SERVICE with reasons (pure/system job body/constant/job definition/no tenant data); getAdapterHealthSummary-style SERVICE_TESTS only if a function reads tenant tables (none expected)
add 'system.status.publish' to the expected job list
add 'system.status.publish' to the scheduled list and the cron table ('* * * * *')

add 'status' to NAMESPACES; create messages/{en,kn,ta}/status.json (component names incl. 'Parsing of documents you share', state labels); update __tests__/catalog.test.ts top-level key list; regenerate generated/** with pnpm --filter @causedeck/i18n i18n:types

preserve.what: system.status.poll (case-watch) job name, registration and tests: packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/status-poll.ts
Workspace object keys ws/<uuid>/<kind>/<yyyy>/<uuid>: objectKey/parseObjectKey behaviour in packages/storage/src/keys.ts stays strict; the public seam must not accept arbitrary paths
Existing migrations and journal ordering in packages/db/migrations; tenant RLS catalog in packages/db/src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts is unchanged (new tables are global)

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/status src/jobs/definitions/status-poll.test.ts src/domains.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}
pnpm --filter @causedeck/worker exec vitest run src/__tests__/registry.test.ts src/__tests__/schedules.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/index.test.ts src/__tests__/status-schema.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}

decisions.choice: Job named system.status.publish, schema workspaceId null/optional, singleton stately
decisions.justification: system jobs must start 'system.' (packages/core/src/jobs/define.ts:90); overlap-safety copies notices-poll.ts:79; system.status.poll is already taken by case-watch

decisions.choice: Incident tables listed in GLOBAL_TABLES, no RLS catalog entry
decisions.justification: notice is the precedent (packages/db/src/conventions.ts:80, index.test.ts:121); tables without workspace_id are exempt from the tenant convention

decisions.choice: Public path written through a new narrow key seam in @causedeck/storage rather than a cast
decisions.justification: ObjectKey is branded and parsed strictly to workspace paths (keys.ts:8,47,67); no new workspace dependency since core already depends on @causedeck/storage (packages/core/package.json:70)

decisions.choice: STATUS_SIGNING_KEY with a dev default modelled on BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
